adaptive_head_stoploss.stopping_bound_method: Global prime index and verify_finite_continuation.stopping_threshold: exact binary range reduction, 24 positive atanh terms, downward rounding on a 10^-18 grid, positive logarithmic bracket before squaring.
adaptive_head_stoploss.scope: Distinct odd original moduli with arbitrary {3,5,7} exponents and every other prime at least 19; no tail support, exponent, graph or prime-count restriction. The full-family head heights, comparison, coupled head density and BBMST restart are separate ordinary mathematical inputs. No greedy optimality claim is needed.

comb_stoploss_dual_transport.scope: Exact feasible primal and dual regressions; the all-height nested-transport proof is stated separately. Each tail objective has its own dual.
